notes.title: Pinball Wicked 1.0
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

[b]The Pinball Wicked release version is live now. 

The Release from Early Access will be tomorrow. 

Thanks for playing Pinball Wicked![/b]


Patch Notes 1.0.8.22
[list]
    [*] updated to Unreal Engine 5     
    [*] TSR Temporal Super Resolution to easily reach higher resolutions like 2K/4K or higher framerates
    [*] New music, legacy music will be selectable only if you bought the game during Early Access. This will be available again in a few days.
    [*] Enhanced Low-End Renderer: Significant visual improvements for the low-end renderer, driven by the brand-new iPhone/iPad version
    [*] better AntiAliasing (TAA & TSR)
    [*] better performance
    [*] cabinet - multi screen support always available and yes, offline too    
    [*] game launches now with DirectX 12 per default. The command line option -dx11 allows to explicitly start with DirectX 11     
    [*] for older GPUs and IGPUS: you can launch with the command line option -OverallQuality=2 to directly start in the Performance Quality Level, or -OverallQuality=1 for Performance+
    [*] removed anti-cheat window title check
    [*]  fixed: Bonus count in dmd now properly displays if the maximum bonus score is reached. Max bonus score increased to 999,999    
[/list]
Fixes and improvements during the beta phase
[list]
    [*]  improved supporter pack glow ball materials for low and medium Material Quality Levels (dependent on Effect Quality setting) to better match the high quality variants and they now emit light on all settings
    [*]  improved manual / instruction card
    [*]  fixed: fullscreen resolution picker is now visible again
    [*]  fixed: spinner coastal reef loop's lights trail the ball again
    [*]  fixed: savegame filename is changed so it does not collide with the UE4 version. Due to binary changes of the savegame file format the local highscores will be reset.
    [*]  fixed: overall quality graphics presets for medium and high, as well as default settings on first start
    [*]  fixed: Medium / High lightmap causing unintended shadows on the playfield
    [*]  fixed: when changing RenderQuality to Performance now AntiAliasing is properly set to TAA and TSR settings are blocked as these are not available with this renderer
    [*]  fixed: mode specific pure/action overrides in the Operator menu are now saved, and Wickedly Random option works properly now
    [*]  fixed: settings - the default button now properly resets all values it's intended to  
    [*]  and more fixes and improvements
[/list] 

What we're working on now, details to follow soon:
[list]
    [*] Leaderboards refresh and upgrade 
    [*] next Table DLCs
    [*] and more
[/list] 

[h3]Stay tuned! Have Fun! Flip out![/h3]

notes.title: Upcoming Pinball Wicked 1.0 Release
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone, it's been a while![/h3]

We're back from limbo with the beta preview of the 1.0 release. We made some great improvements which we believe you will appreciate. The next table will be announced after the full release, so we're confident to get this back on track.

And if you're on the move - now you can get [b]Pinball Wicked: Black Flaggers for iPhone and iPad[/b] - looking and feeling amazingly fresh.


[h3]Changes in the upcoming 1.0 release:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New music, original music will be selectable only if you bought the game in Early Access
[*] Enhanced Low-End Renderer: Significant visual improvements for the low-end renderer, driven by the brand-new iPhone/iPad version
[*] updated to Unreal Engine 5 
[*] TSR temporal super resolution to easily reach higher resolutions 2K/4K or higher framerates
[*] better antialiasing (TAA & TSR)
[*] better performance   
[*] cabinet - multi screen support always available and yes, offline too
[*] removed anti-cheat window title check
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29377610/0aa155133e1641f0778f84fe19f4ab69cee639b9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Preview is now available under Betas/experimental.[/h3]
Here you can find the next version we're currently working on. This includes new features which are not yet thoroughly tested and therefore can contain bugs. 

If you don't want to loose your previous settings or local scores it's best to [b]make a backup of the %LOCALAPPDATA%\PinballWicked folder before testing[/b].  Easiest way is to rename the folder to e.g. PinballWicked.bak

The experimental preview is accessible under Library/Pinball Wicked/[RMB] Properties/Betas in the steam client. 

[h3]Currently on expiremental - 1.0 Release Candidate[/h3]

[list]
    [*] improved supporter pack glow ball materials for low and medium Material Quality Levels (dependent on Effect Quality setting) to better match the high quality variants
    [*] improved manual / instruction card
    [*] the legacy music selection for Early Access players will be available sometime next week
    [*] game launches now with DirectX 12 per default. The command line option -dx11 allows to explicitly start with DirectX 11        
    [*] fixed: Bonus count in dmd now properly displays if the maximum bonus score is reached. Max bonus score increased to 999,999
    [*] fixed: fullscreen resolution picker is now visible again
    [*] fixed: spinner coastal reef loop's lights trail the ball again 
    [*] fixed: savegame filename is changed so it does not collide with the UE4 version
    [*] fixed: overall quality graphics presets for medium and high, as well as default settings on first start
    [*] fixed: when changing RenderQuality to Performance now AntiAliasing is properly set to TAA and TSR settings are blocked as these are not available with this renderer
    [*] fixed: mode specific pure/action overrides in the Operator menu are now saved, and Wickedly Random option works properly now
    [*] and more fixes and improvements
[/list] 

If the default settings are too demanding you can activate the Performance+ overall quality with the command line: 
[code]-OverallQuality=2[/code]
[b]Overall Quality Levels[/b] 
[olist]
[*] Performance+  -  for IGPU
[*] Performance   
[*] Medium   -  better IGPU and budget GPU
[*] High
[*] Wicked   -  mid range GPU
[*] Ultra Wicked 
[/olist]

[b]Known issues in the preview:[/b]
[list]
[*] switching back from the first experimental to the live version will crash on launch due to incompatible savegame format in %LOCALAPPDATA%\PinballWicked\Saved\SaveGames unless the beta BlackFlaggers.sav file is deleted before starting the game. Sorry for this! The current version has this issue fixed.
[/list]



[h3]Stay tuned! Have Fun! Flip out![/h3]

[b]TL;DR -> Full Release soon, next table announcement thereafter. Play on iPhone now too.[/b]

Enhanced Low-End Renderer

notes.title: Update 7 - Kraken Rising
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29377610/f734313b217ef4c5efd732e30915d70fc5dbaa03.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Ahoy fellow Pinball Lovers![/b][/h1]

[h3][b]What's new[/b][/h3]
A new and colorful UI, the pause screen now displays the main missions' progress and more stats than ever. The Kraken shows it's true tentacles. New and improved portrait cameras and settings. Oh, and you'll be happy to know that the Adventures are now a bit easier to reach. 

[h3][b]Update 7 - Kraken Rising - Patch Notes[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Tentacles![/b] Visible in "Action" mode by default, you can enable these for "Pure" via the "Kraken Mode" options in Settings->Operator.
[*] new, improved and beautified UI
[*] Windows desktop display orientation can now be set for the duration of the game via command line arguments (Properties/Set Launch Options...) e.g. 
rotate the main display by 90° / to portrait:  [b]-rotate 90[/b]
rotate display 2 by 270° / to portrait (flipped):  [b]-rotate2 270[/b]  
[*] command line options for Player Count 1-4 (-Players 3) and Game Style (-PureAction 0)
[*] [b]improved cameras:[/b] automatic portrait/landscape switch, camera saved per orientation, better handling of aspect ratios for all cameras, orientations and screen sizes, select aspect ratio constraints (16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4).
[*] dynamic mode for portrait cameras
[*] camera selection now properly filtered and named according to orientation portrait/landscape
[*] improved thumbstick/analog plunger control
[*] seamiles increased by 20% for all lanes/ramps
[*] Online System to support current and upcoming features
[*] EULA and Privacy Policy are now presented on the first game start in addition to the already existing confirmation dialog before the game's installation which is presented by the steam client
[*] feedback: you can now message us directly from within the game, which is especially useful for bug reports as this will transmit some debug information (e.g. ball states). This is currently one way, so if you want a reply please use the other support channels, too.
[*] fixed: Buccaneer Frenzy achievement
[*] fix: using Alt+Enter to switch from windowed to fullscreen will now use only valid resolutions as fullscreen resolution 
[*] fix: the available resolutions are now always properly detected when using multi monitor setups with different diplays
[/list]


[h2]Pinball Cabinet Support Addon[/h2]
Multi Display / Window Support

The pinball cabinet support addon (beta) is a special offering which you can request directly from us. You can find the request form in the Addons menu of the preview build. This feature does require online activation and is currently available for free. 

A backglass and a dmd window can be configured via the settings menu after activation. Custom background images can be added to the folder %LocalAppData%\PinballWicked\Images


Special Thanks to all of you who have taken the time to check out the preview on the experimental branch! 

[h1][i][b]Stay tuned! Have fun! Flip out![/b][/i][/h1]

notes.title: Update 6 - Grand Finale: The Treasure Fleet
notes.content:

[h1][b]Ahoy fellow Pinball Lovers![/b][/h1]

[b]Thanks for all the great feedback!
 
The Black Flaggers table is now complete with all missions in play. The scores and rewards are improved and newly balanced. Vital statistics are now displayed during pause and your notoriety rank, a measure of your success during missions, is now visible on game end. 
[/b]
 

[h1][b]Grand Finale: The Treasure Fleet[/b][/h1]

Gather your crew, track down the fleet, triumph over the defending forces and plunder more gold than you can carry. This mission can be started after completing 5 Adventures or 8 Pirate Battles the first time, after this all Black Flaggers letters have to be lit to start The Treasure Fleet again.
 

[h1][b]Update 6 - The Treasure Fleet - Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[*] new: Pure Steel Ball

[*] balancing: relocation of the Extra Ball and Bonus Held rewards
[*] balancing: updated Loot Event table
[*] balancing: Loot is now limited to 60. This limit is increased by 60 for each completed Treasure Fleet mission. 
[*] some new and improved lights, voices, stingers and dmd graphics
[*] fixed: dead man could be hit after mission end
[*] fixed: mutiny in action mode could spawn too many mutineers
[*] fixed: the super jackpot trigger could be ignored in rare cases
[*] fixed: in very rare cases the super jackpot light could stay lit on ball end 
[*] fixed: in very rare cases a locked ball could be thrown out of the skull
[*] fix regression: Bonus Held works properly again
[*] many, many smaller fixes and improvements
[/list]
 
[h1][i][b]We got a few more improvements we'd like to add to the Black Flaggers in the coming updates, so:

Stay tuned! Have fun! Flip out![/b][/i][/h1]

notes.title: Update 5.3 - The Physics Nudge
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29377610/3d129ddc1b85d1e32f37dbe27c2310ae31330588.jpg[/img]
 
[h1][b]Ahoy fellow Pinball Lovers![/b][/h1]

[b]Thanks for all the great feedback!
 
While we're nearing the completion of Update 6, we got another load of improvements that can't wait. Highlights are enhanced physics accuracy and revised flipper dynamics, better nudge and tilt handling, and many, many smaller fixes.[/b]
 

[h1][b]Update 5.3 - The Physics Nudge - Patch Notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] massive improvements to physics accuracy and flipper dynamics -> grippier & bouncier
[*] balancing: Bang Back / Death Save protection: nudging if a ball is in a lower outlane will regularly result in an instant warning and death saves are a bit more difficult to pull off
[*] balancing: digital left/right nudges are a bit softer now. You can no longer nudge if the table is in TILT! state.
[*] balancing: Extra Balls per game are now limited to 10 in the 5 Ball game. The 3 Ball game is unchanged at max 12 Extra Balls per game.
[*] balancing: Extra Ball Lit now vanishes on ball end
[*] fix: added debounce to the TILT! warning sensor which fixes a possible instant TILT! on a single hard nudge
[*] fixed: ball does not come to rest on an activated flipper
[*] fixed: the ball could get stuck on the beginning of the crow wire ramp
[*] fixed: flickering lamp post lights on experimental Low Rendering
[*] fixed: The Pirate Battle would not always start properly if the third ball is locked instantly after another mission ends
[*] fixed: the game end stats displayed the current Pirate Battles count (same as lit letters) instead of the total count
[*] fixed: in very rare cases a ball can fail to drain properly preventing the ball end in local hot seat mode
[*] fixed: Ball can get stuck behind the skull if you manage to shoot around the mouth ramp and pillars during the Pirate Battle start
[*] fixed: Ball can get stuck behind the right trap door / popup pirate
[*] fixed: game end stats for Pirate battle would only show the values of the current cycle (e.g. 1-8, 9-16,...). This also allows the "We Arr Pirates!" achievement to work as intended. 
[*] fixed: characters could be hit after dying or during their mission end animation
[*] changed Crow and Lighthouse insert light colors to orange
[*] The Bell light now blinks when only one letter is left 
[*] regression fix: music fades out again instead of stopping instantly
[*] added more sounds, voice overs and light shows
[*] new: automatically pause the game if the game controller connection is lost
[*] added informative message box instead of the default Low Level Fatal Error for the incompatible AMD legacy driver 15.7.1 (suggesting the AMD Radeon Software Crimson Edition 16.2.​1 for Non GCN Products). The legacy driver 15.7.1 will work in the 64bit executable which will be added in a later update.
[*] removed some grime: the flippers look a bit cleaner now
[/list]

[h1][i][b]Stay tuned! Have fun! Flip out![/b][/i][/h1]

notes.title: Update 4 - The Dead Man's ALIVE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29377610/a7eea32ea667058184771a369764e24237925869.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Ahoy fellow Pinball Lovers![/b][/h1]

[b]Thanks for all the great feedback![/b]
 

[h1][b]Performance Update - new Render Quality setting[/b][/h1]

Up to and including Update 3 we optimized the game to reach >60 fps in hd / 1920x1080 on mid range graphics cards with the highest possible render quality and fully dynamic lighting, thus the recommended hardware requirements. 

In Update 4 we optimized a lot further, targeting a far wider range of GPUs and higher resolutions. The new Render Quality setting offers new high performance graphics feature presets. Changing this setting will take effect the next time you start the game.

Thanks to the Unreal Engine 4's new volumetric light maps even the moving objects keep looking awesome with precomputed lighting. So if you're out for more fps or a higher resolution you should definitely try the new settings!

[b]Render Quality levels[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Low (Experimental)[/b] is suitable for many integrated GPUs and low end graphics cards, many graphics features are turned off, uses forward rendering and precomputed lighting. This quality level is a work in progress and will change over time.
 
[*][b]Medium[/b] uses mainly precomputed lighting and is suitable for low range graphics cards and mid range integrated GPUs.
 
[*][b]High[/b] mixes precomputed with real time lighting, graphics features are optimized for performance.
 
[*][b]Epic[/b] uses fully dynamic real time lighting for all lights and high end graphics features for the best possible render quality. This matches the only available render quality of Update 3. 
[/list]

On a GTX 970 / i5 2500K / 1920x1080 changing render quality, leaving the other graphics quality settings on epic, using cam 4: 
Low ~260 fps (limited by cpu), Medium ~160 fps, High ~115-135 fps, Epic ~ 65-80 fps

And for a quick boost on epic settings we added the option to configure Distance Field AO and Screen Space Reflections separately - disabling these nets around 10-25% more fps in epic render quality.


[h1][b]Cabinet users rejoice: Portrait orientation now supported in "Fullscreen" too![/b][/h1]

In addition to the screen mode "Windowed Fullscreen", which has worked in portrait orientation since release, you can now also choose full screen portrait resolutions.
 
[h1][b]Enabling portrait mode (vertical screen)[/b][/h1]
[olist]
    [*] Set the display orientation to "Portrait" in the windows display settings:  RMB on empty desktop -> Display settings -> Orientation: Portrait
    [*] Start the game (optionally: choose a resolution and/or screen mode in Options/Graphics)
    [*] Select camera 6 -> Enjoy ːsteamhappyː
[/olist] 


[h1][b]Update 4 - The Dead Man's ALIVE! - patch notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] new: The Dead Man's Chest now with it's very own Dead Man!
[*] new: Render Quality setting: you can now select between different graphic feature / performance presets. Changing this setting takes effect the next time you start the game.
[*] new: extra overrides for high end graphics features, so that these can be deactivated or configured without changing the whole quality groups 
[*] new: Black Flaggers' White Pearl can now be selected as default ball skin
[*] new: [b]Bloom settings in the lighting options[/b]; currently not applied during pause - best set before game start
[*] new: [b]Full Screen mode for portrait display orientation[/b]
[*] new: lighting and audio settings can now be reset to default; not all sound volumes are set to 1.0 by default
[*] fixed: ball loosing too much velocity on flipper collision for most cases; more physics fixes and calibrations
[*] fixed: the ball can get stuck if it drops below the crow ramp (the red one, left orbit) right when the ramp is about to be lowered
[*] fixed: *sometimes* the kickback shoots up the cannon ramp again
[*] UI: new skin, new layout, new!
[*] UI: added descriptions for most settings
[*] UI: fixed mouse hover and keyboard / gamepad highlighting
[*] UI: the game version string is now only visible when the menu is open or the game is paused
[*] UI: fixed - selection of the desktop full screen resolution would sometimes not register as change
[*] balancing: the ball saver kickback is now a lot more unpredictable
[*] balancing: updated Dead Man's Chest scores; success now lights a Super Jackpot
[*] balancing: slingshots are less likely to shoot the ball into the exit lanes
[*] balancing: added two small rubber pegs which make the left exit lane quite a bit less "attractive"
[*] fix: ball rolling and impact sound volumes are now properly applied
[*] audio balancing and sound channel fixes - work in progress, more in future updates 
[*] new ball [strike]drown[/strike] drain sound to mark the ball lost event
[*] possible fix for the occasional waterhole splash hitch
[*] fixed: force feedback could get stuck
[*] fixed: many small issues that were still present in the preview of update 4
[*] new: frame rate hard cap: 240 fps
[*] many more fixes and even more optimizations
[/list]

[b]What we're working on right now[/b]
[list]
[*] VR support for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive
[*] polishing Black Flaggers' sounds / lightshows / fx / dmds
[*] balancing / score table updates
[*] The Grand Finale: The Treasure Fleet
[*] local hot seat multiplayer
[*] Tilt!
[/list]

[h1][i][b]Stay tuned! Have fun! Flip out![/b][/i][/h1]

[h1][b]Performance Update - new Render Quality setting[/b][/h1]

Up to and including Update 3 we optimized the game to reach >60 fps in hd / 1920x1080 on mid range graphics cards with the highest possible render quality and fully dynamic lighting, thus the recommended hardware requirements. 

In Update 4 we optimized a lot further, targeting a far wider range of GPUs and higher resolutions. The new Render Quality setting offers new high performance graphics feature presets. Changing this setting will take effect the next time you start the game.

Thanks to the Unreal Engine 4's new volumetric light maps even the moving objects keep looking awesome with precomputed lighting. So if you're out for more fps or a higher resolution you should definitely try the new settings!

[b]Render Quality levels[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Low (Experimental)[/b]  is suitable for many integrated GPUs and low end graphics cards, many graphics features are turned off, uses forward rendering and precomputed lighting.
 
[*][b]Medium[/b] uses mainly precomputed lighting and is suitable for low range graphics cards and mid range integrated GPUs.
 
[*][b]High[/b] mixes precomputed with real time lighting, graphics features are optimized for performance.
 
[*][b]Epic[/b] uses fully dynamic real time lighting for all lights and high end graphics features for the best possible render quality. This matches the only available render quality of Update 3. 
[/list]

On a GTX 970 / i5 2500K / 1920x1080 changing render quality, leaving the other graphics quality settings on epic, using cam 4: 
Low ~260 fps (limited by cpu), Medium ~160 fps, High ~115-135 fps, Epic ~ 65-80 fps
